data_fields.name: slot_owner_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 owner per item (donor), Frankendom needs up to 3 holders

best_idea: Choose an enemy action as a cost race (action cost plus travel time to the target, goal priority as the starting cost) and take the first executable plan popped.
decision_why: Frankendom's AI brain (row 2) needs a cost-ranked choice between attack, approach and hold plus a slot claim, but a general graph planner per enemy per tick is too heavy for MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; keep the cost race and travel-time term, drop the Burst graph and the non-admissible sum.
acceptance: In a 1-vs-3 fight the three attackers each hold a distinct attack slot (server test: no slot held twice, slot released on cancel); a fourth enemy chooses hold until a slot frees.
